The egui crates (ecolor, egui, egui-wgpu, egui-winit, emath, epaint 0.37.0)
declare MIT OR Apache-2.0 but omit the workspace-root licence files from the
published crate archives. Their `.cargo_vcs_info.json` commit
(7c0b40402271e8d40cda69f87cf3c2617c2e4382) is not published on GitHub, so the two
files here were retrieved from the release tag 0.37.0
(commit 418687fa18fdac8a9b1b6c8f4a2eb1afd2df4c47) on 22 November 2026.

Source: https://github.com/emilk/egui/tree/0.37.0
